# Warlock Auth

> Package: `@warlock.js/auth`

> Authentication system for Warlock.js applications

## Skills

- [auth-basics](@warlock.js/auth/auth-basics/SKILL.md): Start here for @warlock.js/auth configuration, user models, credentials, and application session flows.
- [customize-token-storage](@warlock.js/auth/customize-token-storage/SKILL.md): Customize token storage in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to customize token storage.
- [customize-user-type](@warlock.js/auth/customize-user-type/SKILL.md): Customize user type (multi-user-type auth) in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to customize user type.
- [handle-login-and-logout](@warlock.js/auth/handle-login-and-logout/SKILL.md): Login + logout in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to handle login and logout.
- [login-with-providers](@warlock.js/auth/login-with-providers/SKILL.md): Login with an OAuth provider, passkeys, or a phone code in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to login with providers.
- [manage-tokens](@warlock.js/auth/manage-tokens/SKILL.md): (no description)
- [overview](@warlock.js/auth/overview/SKILL.md): (no description)
- [protect-routes](@warlock.js/auth/protect-routes/SKILL.md): Gate routes with authMiddleware in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to protect routes.
- [register-user](@warlock.js/auth/register-user/SKILL.md): Register-and-issue-tokens flow in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to register user.
- [run-auth-commands](@warlock.js/auth/run-auth-commands/SKILL.md): Run auth commands in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to run auth commands.
- [throttle-login-attempts](@warlock.js/auth/throttle-login-attempts/SKILL.md): (no description)
- [verify-email-and-reset-password](@warlock.js/auth/verify-email-and-reset-password/SKILL.md): Verify email + reset password in @warlock.js/auth; use when you need to verify email and reset password.
